criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 663 identifies Purdue Memorial Union Club (PMUC); the official campus map and Purdue Events listing distinguish PMUC from the main PMU and identify the hotel at 201 N Grant Street. The fresh Blender reopen confirms all 53 transformed GIS ring vertices match the saved shell base within 0.000019 m. The GIS-backed identity and footprint are strong.
criteria.limitations: The project lon/lat conversion is approximate, not a surveyed projection.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The full irregular GIS shell perimeter and orientation are retained at campus coordinates. The evaluated bounds differ from the source ring by roughly 0.6 m in width and 0.4 m in length, consistent with small trim/entry projections; the asset has no arbitrary global translation or scale change.
criteria.limitations: Local conversion uncertainty remains, and the tower/portico position and dimensions are inferred from perspective photographs rather than measured plans.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Official GIS reports seven levels and height-related fields; if undocumented vertical units are feet, Extrution=72 is approximately 21.95 m, near the reopened model height of 21.75 m. The Circle Design Group and Marriott photographs directly show varied pitched slate gables, dormers, and a taller tower, and the current asset contains separate gable/cross-gable roof masses.
criteria.limitations: GIS height units are not documented. No measured exterior elevation or roof plan was found. Ridge/eave elevations, pitch, roof plan and floor spacing remain estimates; renders still show broad simplified roof planes and estimated junctions.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: High-resolution Circle Design Group/White Lodging and Marriott exterior photographs directly identify the hotel and support a red-brick/pale-stone palette, repeated gables and a substantial covered entry. The asset now models a projecting pale tower, tall arched glazing, gabled porte-cochere, paired windows and story bands.
criteria.limitations: The rendered facades remain regular and schematic relative to the photographs. Tower/entry proportions and precise position are not measured; facade bay rhythm and detail vary more in the references than in the model. The Board plan set contains floor plans but no exterior elevations.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh Blender 4.5.15 LTS reopen confirms the expected stable collection with 28 objects/27 meshes, identity campus-coordinate collection convention, no materialless meshes, and no unpacked external image files. The asset has four inspection renders and a detailed source index with raw source snapshots; the current binary SHA-256 is recorded for this grade.
criteria.limitations: Master integration, duplicate replacement, and coordinator-owned manifest refresh were not part of this asset grade.

evidence.assessment_basis: The reopen report predates the current asset by about two seconds, and both report/source evidence describe the second iteration. This script did not write to the asset.

findings: The second iteration resolves the prior evidence gap for roof silhouette and facade identity by adding directly attributable Circle Design Group/White Lodging and Marriott photographs; those photographs support visual form, not measured dimensions.

The model remains a simplified architectural interpretation: facade rhythms and roof intersections are schematic, and vertical dimensions remain estimates because no elevation/roof schedule with documented units was found.
Coordinator should refresh the shared manifest/index and verify the master asset link and placement before integration acceptance.
limitations: Height, floor spacing, roof pitch, roof plan and entry/tower dimensions are not verified by measured elevations or calibrated photos.
Facade and roof details are photo-supported qualitatively but remain schematic and estimated geometrically.
This is an asset-level evaluation; the current master scene and shared manifest were not opened or edited.
